_about: D7/D8 planted-supersession corpus for tools/ask_spotcheck.py (#9095). Authored BY HAND, hermetic, three cases — the standing method (owner, 2026-09-23): run it small and by hand first, show input rows -> output rows. Each case is one knowledge-update pair: an OLD value asserted in an earlier session and a NEW value asserted in a later one. The reader is asked for the CURRENT state, so a correct reader answers the NEW value.
_shape: Each case is question-shaped (the keys _seed_memory consumes) PLUS a `distilled` block naming the two distilled claims the extraction writer would have produced: content (the distilled claim), valid_from (its window start), session_index + turn_index (the source turn it was distilled from), and quote (the source turn's own words). Distilled content is deliberately NOT verbatim-identical to any raw turn: distillation is not transcription, and the identity distinction is what lets the D8 check tell the superseded claim's block apart from the raw turn carrying the same fact.
